text:
Samira Khan: Quick sync - product wants to flip unversioned tokens to prefer v2, but we need to lock down per-route opt-out, quota calc, and the console preview. Thoughts?
Ethan Wright: Agree we should default to v2 but there must be a per-route 'keep_v1' override. Some customers use v1-only payload shapes on /v1/embeddings.
Lina Gomez: Console needs a migration preview that shows expected monthly spend delta and a small sample of diffs for prompts flagged as risky. Not just aggregate numbers.
Raj Patel: Ops concern: if we automatically reroute when v1 is saturated, that could hide capacity problems. We should surface a signal and do a controlled fallback rather than silent reroute.
Samira Khan: Proposal: three-mode behavior for tenant routing preference: "force_v1", "auto_v2_if_unversioned", "prefer_v2". Default set to prefer_v2 for new tenants, and existing tenants stay with current config unless they opt-in.
Ethan Wright: For "auto_v2_if_unversioned" we need to define "compatibility" - wire-level match only, no semantic guarantees. Add header x-compat-mode: soft-fallback so clients can detect it.
Lina Gomez: On the console preview card: show per-route breakdown and allow toggling which routes are included in the shadow run. Also surface an estimated token delta and p95 latency delta.
Raj Patel: Circuit breaker rules: if fallback_rate > 0.5% for a tenant over 10m OR global fallback_rate > 0.2% over 2m, then disable auto-switching for that tenant cohort and page oncall.
Samira Khan: Good. Also add a gentle tenant-facing banner: "We're preparing to route unversioned requests to improved models. Preview impact before we switch." Link to migration troubleshooting.
Ethan Wright: Telemetry: emit redwood.migration.{tenant,route}.{requests,v1_count,v2_count,fallbacks,token_delta}. Include shadow_run_id and cohort label.
Lina Gomez: We should include an option in the preview to run a deterministic small-sample replay for templates that are high-risk so product can eyeball outputs.
Raj Patel: Quota implications: v2 can have different tokenization. Quota calc must accept a shadow_estimate override and persist projected monthly tokens until migration completes. Otherwise billing surprises.
Samira Khan: Edge-case: API keys issued before 2024 include legacy scopes that block v2. We should treat those keys as "pinned_v1" unless tenant flips the pin. Console must allow bulk unpin with audit log.
Ethan Wright: Implementation: add compat_mode column (enum: pinned_v1, pinned_v2, prefer_v2, shadow). Route-manager will check x-client-version header first, then token metadata, then tenant compat.
Lina Gomez: UX: for enterprise customers show a timeline: shadow run start, projected switch date, and rollback window. Also expose a "manual promote" button to apply change per-route.
Raj Patel: Load testing: run a stress test where 5% of production tenants are auto-switched and measure global token throughput and tail latencies. Put results in the runbook.
Samira Khan: infra-bot: can you confirm whether we have existing dashboards that can be reused or we need new ones?
infra-bot: dashboard-check: Found dashboards redwood.routing.overview and redwood.billing. Will add migration preview dashboard template 'redwood.migration.preview' on staging.
Ethan Wright: Security note: JSON schema for v2 responses is slightly different for nested metadata. We must ensure SDKs tolerate unknown fields. Add compatibility note in SDK changelog.
Lina Gomez: Also include an audit event for every tenant opt-in/out action: redwood.audit.tenant_migration.{user,tenant,action,timestamp}.
Raj Patel: Ops: add a soft quota throttle when fallback spikes to preserve SLOs: throttle percentage = min(20%, fallback_rate * 200). Example: fallback_rate 0.5% -> throttle 100%? Wait math off. Maybe throttle = min(20%, fallback_rate * 10).
Ethan Wright: I like a conservative cap: throttle = min(15%, fallback_rate * 8). That keeps it bounded. We'll tune with load tests.
Samira Khan: Action items: Ethan write compat header and SDK note (due Wed), Lina mock console preview and sample diff UI (due Thu), Raj write circuit breaker thresholds + runbook (due Tue), Samira draft RFC with migration cadence + cohort plan (due Fri).
ops-bot: rollout-sim: shadow-run id sr_2026_0412_07 created for staging.
Lina Gomez: Ran a quick smoke: on chat routes median token delta +8%, embeddings -1. We'll upload sample diffs to the preview doc.
Ethan Wright: I'll add the header x-compat-mode in the router and ensure it propagates through proxies.
Samira Khan: Great. Let's reconvene after initial shadow results. Thanks all. :tada:
